display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Failure handling (all drilled on the deployed stack)
• Crash before ack → SQS redelivers after 180 s → claim sees a terminal job → ack without work → still exactly one case.
• Bedrock timeout → job held unknown; never auto-retried (ops recover-job).
• 5 known provider failures → circuit breaker open 60 s; one half-open probe.
• Poison message → DLQ after 5 receives → CloudWatch alarm; no blind redrive.
• Grant revoked mid-job → job blocked (SCOPE_CHANGED).

div.div:
Cost controls
• 100 admitted calls/day (live) · separate eval budget (ceiling 1,500).
• ≤ 2 concurrent jobs · ≤ 2 calls per job · SDK retries disabled.
• Measured: $0.00035 (Nova Lite) / $0.00206 (Nova 2 Lite) per completed job.
